    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int m = scanner.nextInt();
        int l = scanner.nextInt();
        int r = scanner.nextInt();
        long total = (long) n * m;
        int mod = 998244353;
        if (total % 2 != 0) {
            long ans = modexp(r - l + 1, total, mod);
            System.out.println(ans);
        } else {
            int k = r - l + 1;
            int e = r / 2 - l / 2;
            if (l % 2 == 0) {
                e++;
            }
            int o = k - e;
            long ans = modexp(e + o, total, mod);
            ans = (ans + modexp(e - o, total, mod)) % mod;
            ans = (ans * modexp(2, mod - 2, mod)) % mod;
            System.out.println(ans);
        }
    }

    public static long modexp(long a, long power, int mod) {
        if (power == 0) {
            return 1;
        }
        if (power == 1) {
            return a;
        }
        long small = modexp(a, power / 2, mod);
        long ans = (small % mod * small % mod) % mod;
        if (power % 2 != 0) {
            ans = (ans % mod * a % mod) % mod;
        }
        return ans;
    }
}
